claim.text: Normalized true error of the Padua interpolant at degree 60 for the Franke function F1 on the unit square (drvrec, FAMILY 1, NTG1 100), Table I of the pre-publication draft: 2E-11. Absolute tolerance 5e-12 (the printed value stands for [1.5E-11, 2.5E-11]). Registered 2026-11-27T03:28Z.

values.name: normalized true error, F1, degree 60, square

attempt: Reproduced as the authors document: the archive ships no Makefile; Doc/README gives the compile line for drvrec with gfortran, using the documented blas/*.f alternative to -lblas, -O2 (the README's usual FFLAGS). No source file was edited. The driver prints Actual error (MAXERR / MAXDEV, the normalized true error of Table I) = 0.2468E-10 in both passes, i.e. 2.468e-11 against the paper's 2e-11: inside the tolerance (|diff| 4.68e-12 <= 5e-12), but at 94% of it (flagged by the ledger at 80% or more). The driver's source also contains a constant 'Expected error 0.2468D-10'; it is not used as the oracle, and the value registered in the queue is the paper's Table I. The shipped Results/ files are not used (queue note: their coordinates do not match the target grid). Toolchain: gfortran 16.2.0 (conda-forge) in the sandbox scratch. Caveat: the claim reads the pre-publication draft; the published TOMS table may differ. Replay (G5) not yet run.

original_attempt.reason: the documented compile line built drvrec and it ran to completion with no source edit (exit 0 in both passes)
